messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — GPU CI started failing across several runners after the base-image bump to nvidia-driver 535. Jobs show NVML timeouts and occasional 'NVRM: Xid 31' kernel resets. Failing run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/98765

ci-bot: GPU job failed: tests/gpu/inference · job #98765 (runner: gpu-1) :warning:

Maya: I can repro locally on our gpu-test image. docker run + nvidia-smi hangs and then we get:
```
NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:00:1: GPU has fallen off the bus
NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1): 31, PID=4321, Name: python
NVML: timeout while waiting for nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex
```

Tony: Xid 31 usually indicates a GPU page fault or kernel crash. We bumped driver -> 535 and are still on CUDA 12.2 in the container, might be a driver/CUDA combo issue. Which runners are affected (A100 vs V100)?

Jordan: A100 in prod and ampere ci pools so far. Also saw a couple on older Tesla T4s but less consistent.

Hailey: I can take a bisect across the image commits (23.4.1 -> 23.5.0) to find the exact bump. Would help if someone can trigger a rerun with driver pinned to 530 as a quick confirm. @Raj?

Raj: Rerun kicked with OVERRIDE_DRIVER=530 env on the failing job: https://ci.redwood.dev/reruns/98766. Note: I also tried NVML_TIMEOUT=60 and it didn't prevent the NVRM Xid in my local run.

Maya: Also saw OOM-ish behavior in test logs right before reset for the large-model smoke test (batch_size=1). Probably the kernel reset causes the OOM trace.

Tony: Plan: Hailey bisects image commits. If culprit is driver bump -> revert/pin driver in infra images and add smoke coverage. If culprit is CUDA/runtime mismatch -> we'll need to update container CUDA or downgrade driver accordingly. For now mark the suite flaky and skip gating on the gpu-image-bumped jobs.

Jordan: Sounds good. Hailey — please update when bisect finishes. I'll open an incident doc if we need an immediate infra roll back. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Rerun #98766 finished — job succeeded on runner with driver 530.

Hailey: Bisect done — culprit is infra/images commit abc123 which bumped nvidia-driver 530 -> 535. Verified multiple passes on 530, reproducible failure on 535. I'll open PR to pin to 530 and add an image-smoke test that validates nvidia-smi + small kernel job.

Jordan: Excellent, thanks. Once PR lands let's unblock the gating tests and re-run the affected pipelines.

Raj: PR #1034 opened to pin driver and add smoke test. Linking: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/images/pulls/1034

Tony: After PR merges, we should also add a CI check that validates driver+CUDA compatibility matrix to avoid regressions.

Jordan: Agreed. Closing the loop here — thanks everyone for the quick triage.
